android.desc:
Flowist is a minimalist daily planner, study organizer, and digital notebook that unites your to-do list, habit tracker, Pomodoro focus timer, and rich-text notes in one workspace. Stop switching between four different apps. Whether you are a student organizing lecture notes and assignment deadlines, or a professional managing deep-work sprints, Flowist gives you the clarity to focus on what matters.

KEY FEATURES FOR DAILY PRODUCTIVITY:

MINIMALIST NOTES & SKETCH NOTEBOOK
• Rich-Text Notes & Markdown: A clean text editor with standard markdown shortcuts and instant slash (/) commands for rapid formatting.
• Connected Workspace: Use "@" mentions inside notes or tasks to link related items together and jump between them instantly.
• Zero-Lag Sketch Canvas: Handwrite diagrams, wireframes, flowcharts, and lecture notes directly inside the app.
• Stylus & Apple Pencil Ready: Smooth writing experience equipped with palm rejection and vertical continuous pages.
• Biometric Lock: Keep your personal journal, thoughts, and sensitive study notes private with fingerprint or face identification.


SMART TO-DO LIST & DAILY PLANNER
• Eisenhower Matrix: Prioritize effortlessly by categorizing tasks into clean Urgent vs. Important quadrants (up to 10 tasks per quadrant).
• Checklists & Reminders: Plan your day with clean checklists, priority flags, and recurring reminders.
• Natural-Language Input: Type reminders naturally, track subtasks, and instantly convert thoughts into scheduled actions.
• Integrated Calendar Planner: Schedule your study sessions, view your weekly timeline, and track assignment deadlines.


HABIT TRACKER WITH ROUTINES & STREAKS
• Routine Stacking: Build lasting habits by grouping tasks into custom Morning, Afternoon, and Evening routine stacks.
• Counter Habits: Track numeric progress for goals like water intake (glasses) or reading (pages).
• Consistency Heatmaps: Monitor your daily progress with GitHub-style 14-day consistency heatmaps and streak counters to stay motivated.


POMODORO FOCUS TIMER & STUDY PLANNER
• Deep Work Sprints: Beat procrastination using a customizable Pomodoro study timer designed for deep focus.
• Auto-Tick Habit Sessions: Launch a focus timer directly from your habit list (e.g., start a 25-minute meditation or study block with one tap).
• Detailed Productivity Logs: View comprehensive focus logs and track your historical productivity trends over time.
